68301.meaning1: goes wrong; fails; goes off course; comes to nought

examples.text: thaddha-visama-bhūmibhāgasmiñ'hi caṅkame caṅkamantassa pādā rujjanti, phoṭā uṭṭhahanti, cittaṃ ek'aggaṃ na labhati, kammaṭṭhānaṃ vipajjati.
buddhā saṅgāhakā loke, tehi etaṃ sudesitaṃ, eso hetu mahantassa, pathabyo me na vipajjati.
iti kho, puṇṇa, sampajjamānaṃ kukkuravataṃ kukkurānaṃ sahabyataṃ upaneti, vipajjamānaṃ nirayan'ti. evaṃ vutte, acelo seniyo kukkuravatiko parodi, assūni pavattesi.

68306.commentary: (ANa) katamo ca puggalo vipañcitaññū, yassa puggalassa vitthārena atthe vibhajiyamāne dhamm'ābhisamayo hoti, ayaṃ vuccati puggalo vipañcitaññū.

examples.text: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. katame cattāro? ugghaṭitaññū, vipañcitaññū, neyyo, padaparamo, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.

68307.meaning1: who grasps the meaning of a detailed explanation
68307.commentary: (ANa) katamo ca puggalo vipañcitaññū, yassa puggalassa vitthārena atthe vibhajiyamāne dhamm'ābhisamayo hoti, ayaṃ vuccati puggalo vipañcitaññū.

examples.text: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. katame cattāro? ugghaṭitaññū, vipañcitaññū, neyyo, padaparamo, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.

68310.meaning1: splits open; cracks apart; breaks open

examples.text: yañ'hi, brāhmaṇa, tathāgato abhivādeyya vā paccuṭṭheyya vā āsanena vā nimanteyya, muddhā'pi tassa vipateyyā'ti.

68311.meaning1: split up; cracked open; broken apart

examples.text: ime kho te, bhikkhave, mahārukkhā aṇubījā mahākāyā rukkhānaṃ ajjhāruhā, yehi rukkhā ajjhārūḷhā obhaggavibhaggā vipatitā senti.

68313.meaning1: failure; error; going wrong; going astray (of)
68313.commentary: (ANa) kā vipattī'ti. yā tass'eva sīlassa ca ājīvassa ca vipatti, ayam'assa vipatti. apica yāya esa caṇḍālo c'eva hoti malañ'ca patikuṭṭho ca, sā'pi tassa vipattī'ti veditabbā. te ca atthato assaddhiyādayo pañca dhammā honti.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇ'ātipātī hoti, adinn'ādāyī hoti, kāmesumicchācārī hoti, musāvādī hoti, pisuṇavāco hoti, pharusavāco hoti, samphappalāpī hoti. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sīlavipatti.

68318.meaning1: wrong path; bad road; evil way

examples.text: paññāya chetvā vipath'ānusārinaṃ, yogena niggayha pathe nivesiya, disvā samudayaṃ vibhavañ'ca sambhavaṃ, dāy'ādako hehisi aggavādino.

68319.meaning1: following the wrong road; going the wrong way

examples.text: paññāya chetvā vipath'ānusārinaṃ, yogena niggayha pathe nivesiya, disvā samudayaṃ vibhavañ'ca sambhavaṃ, dāy'ādako hehisi aggavādino.

68320.meaning2: having failed, having gone wrong, perished

examples.text: kodhano upanāhī ca, pāpamakkhī ca yo naro, vipannadiṭṭhi māyāvī, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.

68321.meaning1: without; not having; without a correct

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū evarūpāni kammāni karonti, adhammena vaggakammaṃ karonti, adhammena samaggakammaṃ karonti, dhammena vaggakammaṃ karonti, dhammapatirūpakena vaggakammaṃ karonti, dhammapatirūpakena samaggakammaṃ karonti, ñattivipannam'pi kammaṃ karonti anussāvanasampannaṃ, anussāvanavipannam'pi

68322.meaning1: who has wrong view; with perverted belief

examples.text: kodhano upanāhī ca, pāpamakkhī ca yo naro, vipannadiṭṭhi māyāvī, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.

68325.meaning1: releases; lets go (of); casts off; shakes off; sheds

68326.commentary: (MNa) viparāmoso'ti himaviparāmoso gumbaviparāmoso'ti duvidho. yaṃ himapātasamaye himena paṭicchannā hutvā maggapaṭipannaṃ janaṃ musanti, ayaṃ himaviparāmoso. yaṃ gumb'ādīhi paṭicchannā musanti, ayaṃ gumbaviparāmoso.

examples.text: tulākūṭa kaṃsakūṭa mānakūṭa ukkoṭana vañcana nikati sāciyoga chedana vadha bandhana viparāmosa ālopa sāhasākārā paṭivirato ahosi.

micchāpaṭipanno tvam'asi, aham'asmi sammāpaṭipanno. sahitaṃ me, asahitaṃ te. purevacanīyaṃ pacchā avaca, pacchāvacanīyaṃ pure avaca. adhiciṇṇaṃ te viparāvattaṃ. āropito te vādo, cara vādappamokkhāya. niggahito'si, nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosī'ti.
yaṃ, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ atītaṃ niruddhaṃ vipariṇataṃ ahosī'ti tassa saṅkhā, ahosī'ti tassa samaññā, ahosī'ti tassa paññatti, na tassa saṅkhā atthī'ti, na tassa saṅkhā bhavissatī'ti.
tatrā'pi te, phagguna, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na c'eva me cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ bhavissati, na ca pāpikaṃ vācaṃ nicchāressāmi, hit'ānukampī ca viharissāmi mettacitto, na dos'antaro'ti.

68330.commentary: (VIN 1.2.2) vipariṇatan'ti rattam'pi cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ. duṭṭham'pi cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ. mūḷham'pi cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ. apica, rattaṃ cittaṃ imasmiṃ atthe adhippetaṃ vipariṇatan'ti.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmena saddhiṃ kāyasaṃsaggaṃ samāpajjeyya hatthaggāhaṃ vā veṇiggāhaṃ vā aññatarassa vā aññatarassa vā aṅgassa parāmasanaṃ, saṅgh'ādiseso.
tassa, ahaṃ rūpaṃ, mama rūpan'ti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyino taṃ rūpaṃ vipariṇamati aññathā hoti.

satt'ime kāyā akaṭā akaṭavidhā animmitā animmātā vañjhā kūṭaṭṭhā esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā, te na iñjanti na vipariṇamanti na aññam'aññaṃ byābādhenti n'ālaṃ aññam'aññassa sukhāya vā dukkhāya vā sukhadukkhāya vā.
mamāyitaṃ vatthuṃ vipariṇāma-saṃkino'pi phandanti, vipariṇamante'pi phandanti, vipariṇate'pi phandanti
tassa rūpa-vipariṇāma-aññathābhāvā uppajjanti soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā.
yaṃ pan'āniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ, etaṃ mama, eso'ham'asmi, eso me attā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
piyānaṃ kho, nāgita, vipariṇām'aññathābhāvā uppajjanti soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā, eso tassa nissando.

68335.meaning1: unpleasant when changing; uncomfortable while altering

examples.text: sukhā kho, āvuso visākha, vedanā ṭhitisukhā vipariṇāmadukkhā. dukkhā vedanā ṭhitidukkhā vipariṇāmasukhā. adukkham'asukhā vedanā ñāṇasukhā aññāṇadukkhā'ti.

68337.meaning1: suffering inherent in transformation; dukkha of change
68337.commentary: (DNa) vipariṇāmadukkhatā'ti vipariṇāme dukkhatā. sukhavedanāy'etaṃ nāmaṃ. sukhassa hi vipariṇāme dukkhaṃ uppajjati, tasmā sukhaṃ vipariṇāmadukkhatā'ti vuttaṃ. apica ṭhapetvā dukkhavedanaṃ sukhavedanañ'ca sabbe'pi tebhūmakā dhammā sabbe saṅkhārā dukkhā'ti vacanato saṅkhāradukkhatā'ti veditabbā.

examples.text: tisso dukkhatā, dukkhadukkhatā, saṅkhāradukkhatā, vipariṇāmadukkhatā.

68338.meaning1: changing in nature; of changing character

examples.text: yaṃ rūpaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ rūpassa assādo. yaṃ rūpaṃ aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, ayaṃ rūpassa ādīnavo.
yaṃ pan'āniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ, etaṃ mama, eso'ham'asmi, eso me attā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

68339.meaning1: fact of susceptibility to change; liability to change

examples.text: tassā hi nāma, āvuso, bāhirāya pathavīdhātuyā tāva mahallikāya aniccatā paññāyissati, khayadhammatā paññāyissati, vayadhammatā paññāyissati, vipariṇāmadhammatā paññāyissati.

68340.meaning1: pleasant when changing; comfortable while altering

examples.text: sukhā kho, āvuso visākha, vedanā ṭhitisukhā vipariṇāmadukkhā. dukkhā vedanā ṭhitidukkhā vipariṇāmasukhā. adukkham'asukhā vedanā ñāṇasukhā aññāṇadukkhā'ti.

68341.meaning1: change, fading and ending; alteration, weakening and cessation
68341.compound: dvanda (vipariṇāma ca virāga ca nirodha ca)
68341.commentary: (MNa) vipariṇāmavirāganirodhan'ti pakativijahanena vipariṇāmaṃ, vigacchanena virāgaṃ, nirujjhanena nirodhaṃ.

examples.text: dhammānaṃ tv'eva aniccataṃ viditvā vipariṇāmavirāganirodhaṃ, pubbe c'eva dhammā eta'r'ahi ca sabbe te dhammā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā'ti evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato uppajjati somanassaṃ.
rūp'ārāmā, bhikkhave, devamanussā rūparatā rūpasammuditā. rūpavipariṇāmavirāganirodhā dukkhā, bhikkhave, devamanussā viharanti.

68342.meaningLit: caused to be completely bent around

examples.text: tayi gedhitacitto'smi, cittaṃ vipariṇāmitaṃ, paṭigantuṃ na sakkomi, vaṅkaghasto'va ambujo.
cakkhu aniccaṃ vipariṇāmi aññathābhāvi. rūpā aniccā vipariṇāmino aññathābhāvino. itth'etaṃ dvayaṃ calañ'c'eva byathañ'ca aniccaṃ vipariṇāmi aññathābhāvi.

68344.commentary: (MNa) na vipariṇāmentī'ti pakatiṃ na jahanti. (MNt) aniñjanañ'ca atthato pakatiyā avaṭṭhānam'evā'ti dassetuṃ na vipariṇāmentī'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: kismiṃ nu kho, bhikkhave, sati, kiṃ upādāya, kiṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati, satt'ime kāyā akaṭā, akaṭavidhā, animmitā, animmātā, vañjhā, kūṭaṭṭhā, esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā, te na iñjanti, na vipariṇāmenti, na aññam'aññaṃ byābādhenti, n'ālaṃ aññam'aññassa sukhāya vā dukkhāya vā sukhadukkhāya vā.

yv'āyaṃ gahapati, mato kālaṅ'kato tassa kāyasaṅkhāro niruddho paṭippassaddho, vacīsaṅkhāro niruddho paṭippassaddho, cittasaṅkhāro niruddho paṭippassaddho, āyu parikkhīṇo, usmā vūpasantā, indriyāni viparibhinnāni.
488, 481. ha vipariyayo lo vā.
hakārassa vipariyayo hoti yapaccaye pare, yapaccayassa ca lo hoti vā. vulhati, vuyhati.

68351.meaning1: goes around; drives around; travels here and there

examples.text: evaṃ su te kuttavālehi vaḷavārathehi dīghāhi patodalaṭṭhīhi vāhane vitudentā vipariyāyanti, seyyathā'pi tvaṃ eta'r'ahi sācariyako'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho gotama.

68352.commentary: (JAa) yaṃ pan'etaṃ tesaṃ paṭighāt'atthāya yaññakammaṃ vattati, taṃ vipariyāso vattati viparītato vattati, vipallāsena vattatī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: so evam'āha, ahaṃ kho, āvuso, ummādaṃ pāpuṇiṃ cetaso vipariyāsaṃ. tena me ummattakena bahuṃ assāmaṇakaṃ ajjhāciṇṇaṃ bhāsitaparikkantaṃ.
maṇḍūkiyo kaṇhasappe gilanti, kākaṃ supaṇṇā parivārayanti, tasā vakā eḷakānaṃ bhayāhi, vipariyāso vattati na'y'idha matthī'ti.
saññāya vipariyesā, cittaṃ te pariḍayhati, nimittaṃ parivajjehi, subhaṃ rāg'ūpasaṃhitaṃ.

68358.meaning2: having turned around; having inverted; having reversed

68360.grammar: pp of vi pari √i, in comps, neg
68360.meaning1: inverted; distorted; upside down; perverse; wrong

examples.text: micchādiṭṭhiko hoti viparītadassano, n'atthi dinnaṃ, n'atthi yiṭṭhaṃ, n'atthi hutaṃ, n'atthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, n'atthi ayaṃ loko, n'atthi paro loko
asu ca, bho gotama, kuṭṭhī puriso arugatto pakkagatto kimīhi khajjamāno nakhehi vaṇamukhāni vippatacchamāno upahat'indriyo dukkhasamphasse'y'eva aggismiṃ sukham'iti viparītasaññaṃ paccalatthā'ti.
517, 488. kvaci dhātu vibhatti paccayānaṃ dīgha viparīt'ādesa lop'āgamā ca.

examples.text: yathā haritālena makkhitaṃ, addasa cittikaṃ bhittiyā kataṃ, tamhi te viparītadassanaṃ, saññā mānusikā niratthikā.

68365.meaning1: with a distorted view; with inverted perception; who sees things upside down

examples.text: micchādiṭṭhiko kho pana hoti viparītadassano, n'atthi dinnaṃ n'atthi yiṭṭhaṃ n'atthi hutaṃ, n'atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, n'atthi ayaṃ loko n'atthi paro loko, n'atthi mātā n'atthi pitā
asu ca, bho gotama, kuṭṭhī puriso arugatto pakkagatto kimīhi khajjamāno nakhehi vaṇamukhāni vippatacchamāno upahat'indriyo dukkhasamphasse'y'eva aggismiṃ sukham'iti viparītasaññaṃ paccalatthā'ti.

68370.construction: vi + pari > pali > paly > pall + √as + ta

examples.text: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, saññāvipallāsā cittavipallāsā diṭṭhivipallāsā. katame cattāro?

68373.construction: vi + pari > pali > paly > pall + √as > ās + *a
68373.commentary: (VINa) vipallāsam'pi sattā paṭilabheyyun'ti viparītaggāham'pi sattā sampāpuṇeyyuṃ. kathaṃ? ayaṃ nu kho pathavī, udāhu na ayan'ti. atha vā amhākaṃ nu kho ayaṃ gāmo, udāhu aññesan'ti.

68375.meaning1: who has clear insight; who perceives distinctly

examples.text: taṃ jhāyinaṃ sātatikaṃ, sukhumadiṭṭhivipassakaṃ, upādānakkhay'ārāmaṃ, āhu sappuriso iti.
indriyesu guttadvārā bhavissāma, bhojane mattaññuno, jāgariyaṃ anuyuttā, vipassakā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ, pubbaratt'āpararattaṃ bodhipakkhiyānaṃ dhammānaṃ, bhāvan'ānuyogam'anuyuttā viharissāmā'ti.

68376.meaning1: sees deeply (into); sees in detail; understands with insight; has insight into

examples.text: andhabhūto ayaṃ loko, tanuk'ettha vipassati, sakuṇo jālamutto'va, appo saggāya gacchati.
ākiñcaññasambhavaṃ ñatvā, nandī saṃyojanaṃ iti, evam'etaṃ abhiññāya, tato vipassati, etaṃ ñāṇaṃ tathaṃ tassa, brāhmaṇassa vusīmato'ti.
idh'āvuso, sammādiṭṭhi sīl'ānuggahitā ca hoti, sut'ānuggahitā ca hoti, sākacch'ānuggahitā ca hoti, samath'ānuggahitā ca hoti, vipassanā-anuggahitā ca hoti.

ākaṅkheyya ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu, sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo c'assaṃ manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cā'ti, sīlesv'ev'assa paripūrakārī ajjhattaṃ cetosamatham'anuyutto anirākatajjhāno vipassanāya samannāgato brūhetā suññ'āgārānaṃ.

68379.meaning1: due to the practice of insight meditation

68381.meaning1: insight knowledge; wisdom from penetrating internal vision

examples.text: ñāṇañ'ca pana me dassanaṃ udapādi akuppā me vimutti, ayam'antimā jātī'ti ettha paccavekkhaṇañāṇaṃ idha pana ñāṇadassanāya cittan'ti idaṃ vipassanāñāṇaṃ ñāṇadassananti vuttan'ti.

68382.meaning1: obligation of introspection; responsibility of developing insight
68382.commentary: (DHPa) katamaṃ pana, bhante, ganthadhuraṃ, katamaṃ vipassanādhuran'ti? attano paññ'ānurūpena ekaṃ vā dve vā nikāye sakalaṃ vā pana tepiṭakaṃ buddhavacanaṃ uggaṇhitvā tassa dhāraṇaṃ, kathanaṃ, vācanan'ti idaṃ ganthadhuraṃ nāma, sallahukavuttino pana pantasen'āsan'ābhiratassa attabhāve khayavayaṃ paṭṭhapetvā sātaccakiriyavasena vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā arahattaggahaṇan'ti idaṃ vipassanādhuraṃ nāmā'ti.

examples.text: so taṃ disvā, bhante, imasmiṃ sāsane kati dhurāni nāmā'ti pucchi. āvuso, vipassanādhuraṃ, ganthadhuran'ti. bhante, gantho nāma paṭibalassa bhāro, mayhaṃ pana dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, vipassanādhuraṃ pūressāmi kammaṭṭhānaṃ me dethā'ti vanditvā nisīdi.

68384.meaning1: supported by insight; assisted by introspection

examples.text: idh'āvuso, sammādiṭṭhi sīl'ānuggahitā ca hoti, sut'ānuggahitā ca hoti, sākacch'ānuggahitā ca hoti, samath'ānuggahitā ca hoti, vipassan'ānuggahitā ca hoti.

68386.meaning1: wisdom of insight; knowledge from introspection

68387.meaning1: accompanied by the wisdom of insight

68389.meaning1: preceded by insight; with insight first
68389.commentary: (ANa) vipassanāpubbaṅ'gaman'ti vipassanaṃ pubbaṅ'gamaṃ purecārikaṃ katvā samathaṃ bhāveti, pakatiyā vipassanālābhī vipassanāya ṭhatvā samādhiṃ uppādetī'ti attho.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu vipassanāpubbaṅ'gamaṃ samathaṃ bhāveti. tassa vipassanāpubbaṅ'gamaṃ samathaṃ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati. so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.

68394.meaning1: who gets insight; who gains understanding

68396.meaning2: what is called perception of insight

68397.commentary: (PMa) kathaṃ vipassanāvasena? sappītike dve jhāne samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhāya jhānasampayuttaṃ pītiṃ khayato vayato sammasati. evaṃ vipassanākkhaṇe jhānasampayuttaṃ pītiṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā cittaṃ āmodeti pamodeti. evaṃ paṭipanno abhippamodayaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmi passasissāmī'ti sikkhatī'ti vuccati.

examples.text: kati saṅkhār'upekkhā vipassanāvasena uppajjanti? aṭṭha saṅkhār'upekkhā samathavasena uppajjanti. dasa saṅkhār'upekkhā vipassanāvasena uppajjanti.

68398.meaning1: mental sequence of insight; cognitive series of insight

68399.meaning1: blemish of insight; imperfection of introspection
68399.commentary: (VISM) ath'assa imāya taruṇavipassanāya āraddhavipassakassa dasa vipassan'upakkilesā uppajjanti. vipassan'upakkilesā hi paṭivedhappattassa ariyasāvakassa c'eva vippaṭipannakassa ca nikkhittakammaṭṭhānassa kusītapuggalassa n'uppajjanti. sammāpaṭipannakassa pana yuttapayuttassa āraddhavipassakassa kulaputtassa uppajjanti'y'eva.
